_comment: Mass-deployment. Copy this folder to each PC (or force-install a packed CRX). Set enabled to true for branding. allowedOrigins is the security allowlist (scheme+host+port only) — pages not listed never receive bookmarks. appUrl’s origin is also allowed. Include Docker https://localhost:8443 and http://localhost:8090 for local containers. syncDefaultOn false = users must turn Bookmark sync On in the popup. locked:true applies org branding and disables the Branding tab. For production, list only your LinkNest origin(s) and remove localhost.
name: Your Organisation Bookmark Sync
